description: CloudBase 告警规则配置文件（T-1008）

crash_rate.query: SELECT count(*) FROM crash_reports WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

anr_count.query: SELECT count(*) FROM anr_reports WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

measure_success_rate.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / count(*)) AS pct FROM measure_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

measure_avg_duration.query: SELECT avg(duration_ms) FROM measure_metrics WHERE result = 'SUCCESS' AND timestamp >= now() - 15m

measure_fail_rate.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN result != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / count(*)) AS pct FROM measure_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

sync_success_rate.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / count(*)) AS pct FROM sync_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

sync_avg_duration.query: SELECT avg(duration_ms) FROM sync_metrics WHERE result = 'SUCCESS' AND timestamp >= now() - 15m

conflict_rate.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN conflict_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / count(*)) AS pct FROM sync_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

ble_connect_success_rate.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'CONNECT_END' AND success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'CONNECT_START' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS pct FROM ble_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m

ble_disconnect_rate.query: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'DISCONNECT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'CONNECT_END' AND success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS pct FROM ble_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - 15m
